name: Need for a Cure
summary: Rhinag lies poisoned on Durotar’s northwestern cliffs, far from the cure he needs. The Darkspear troll has little time before the venom kills him, so he sends a passing courier to Orgrimmar for Kor'ghan’s remedy.

sections.title: A Scorpid's Sting
sections.body: Rhinag was fighting venomtail scorpids near Durotar’s border when one stung him. Their venom can kill in less than an hour. The poison keeps him from walking to Orgrimmar, so his survival depends on a traveler reaching his remote camp in time.

sections.title: Secrets in the Shadows
sections.body: Rhinag sends travelers beneath Orgrimmar to the Cleft of Shadow, where Kor'ghan knows how to counter the poisons of Durotar’s wastes. Kor'ghan can brew a cure, though he rarely helps those who have not proved themselves.

faq.answer: Rhinag is a Darkspear troll adventurer clinging to life on Durotar’s northwestern cliffs. A venomtail scorpid stung him, and he fears the mockery of his kin in Sen'jin Village if he returns in such a humbled state.

faq.q: Why is Kor'ghan in the Cleft of Shadow?
faq.answer: Kor'ghan makes his home in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. Warlocks, rogues, and others who practice the dark arts work there beyond the eyes of Thrall’s honored warriors, and Kor'ghan’s knowledge of venomous brews and grueling trials suits the caverns.

faq.q: Why doesn't Rhinag just seek a shaman or healer in Sen'jin Village?
faq.answer: Rhinag says pride keeps him from seeking help in Sen'jin Village. He fears his fellow trolls will mock him for returning careless and stricken by venom, so he seeks a discreet remedy from Kor'ghan.

faq.q: What happens after Rhinag receives the antidote?
faq.answer: Rhinag drinks the antidote and recovers, but Kor'ghan demands more of him. The curer expects him to face grueling trials, including slaying boars and gathering scorpid tails, before he earns Kor'ghan’s good graces again.
Rhinag can be found in the rugged bluffs of northwestern Durotar, near the border passes leading west toward the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is there such an urgent rush for this cure?
faq.answer: The venomtail scorpid’s poison is potent enough to overwhelm a victim’s vital organs in less than an hour without treatment.

angles.text: As a troll, you can see how Rhinag fears the mockery of his kin in Sen'jin Village. Among the Darkspear, carelessness in wilderness survival invites harsh ridicule.
As a member of the Horde, you face Durotar’s rocky, unforgiving terrain, a trial for defenders newly arrived in Thrall’s young realm.
